tools.name: create_personalized_song
tools.title: Create a personalized song with audio
tools.description: Create a 30-second personalized song (lyrics + signed mp3 URL valid 24 h) that sings the given name. For adult-facing apps only (parents, teachers). Send a free CucuTime developer key as Authorization: Bearer <key> in Claude Code, Cursor or the REST API; MCP connectors (Claude.ai and other clients with OAuth support) can use https://cucutime.org/mcp/auth with Google sign-in instead.

name.description: First name only (no surnames or personal data), 1-40 letters, to sing.

theme.description: What the song is about (3-300 characters).

age.description: Optional age, used only to adapt the lyrics.

tools.name: generate_song_idea
tools.title: Draft a song idea
tools.description: Draft a song (title, music style and chorus) for a first name and a theme. Use for brainstorming or before creating the real song; this returns a text concept, not audio, plus 3 CucuTime YouTube videos on the theme. Free, no key.

name.description: Child’s first name only (no surnames or personal data).

theme.description: What the song is about (e.g. space, bedtime, a birthday).

tools.name: get_song_for_name
tools.title: Find a name page and free sample link
tools.description: Find the ready-made CucuTime page and free sample link for a child’s first name. Use when a parent wants to visit or listen, rather than brainstorm. When a pre-recorded 30-second sample exists for that name and language, also returns its direct mp3 link (made in advance; no AI runs on the call), plus 3 CucuTime YouTube videos. If no page exists, returns a text idea and sample link instead. Free, no key.

name.description: Child’s first name only (no surnames or personal data).

tools.name: moderate_kids_text
tools.title: Check text for young children
tools.description: Check whether a text is appropriate for young children (ages 2-8). Returns {safe}. For adult-facing apps only. Send a free CucuTime developer key as Authorization: Bearer <key> in Claude Code, Cursor or the REST API; MCP connectors (Claude.ai and other clients with OAuth support) can use https://cucutime.org/mcp/auth with Google sign-in instead.

tools.name: search_catalog
tools.title: Find songs in the CucuTime catalog
tools.description: Find existing CucuTime songs and educational videos by words in their titles, in English, Spanish or Portuguese. Returns YouTube links; use for classroom routines or songs to watch now. If there are no exact matches, check suggestions and approximate alternatives. Free, no key, no AI.

query.description: Words to look for in the title (empty = latest).

resources.name: catalog-themes
resources.title: Catalog themes and languages
resources.description: Title keywords and video counts from CucuTime own upload records, grouped by language.

resources.name: get-a-key
resources.title: Get and configure a developer key
resources.description: Free adult-only trial, client setup and Bearer authentication.

prompts.name: birthday-song
prompts.title: Plan a birthday song
prompts.description: Find a name page and draft a birthday song before making audio.

prompts.name: classroom-routine
prompts.title: Find a classroom routine song
prompts.description: Search existing songs for a classroom routine.

prompts.name: kid-safe-check
prompts.title: Check text for young children
prompts.description: Check text using the adult-only moderation tool, or learn how to connect for it.
